events.description: Puzanov introduces Soviet Academy of Sciences delegation to Hafizullah Amin at Ministry of Foreign Affairs; Amin pledges maximum assistance and says there are no secrets from the Soviets.
Saur (April) Revolution brings the PDPA to power in Afghanistan.
Puzanov introduced the USSR Academy of Sciences delegation led by Asimov to Amin at the Foreign Ministry; discussed scientific and cultural cooperation.
Soviet Academy of Sciences delegation arrived in Afghanistan for talks on scientific cooperation.
Saur (April) Revolution referenced as the victory of the PDPA.

key_claims: Amin publicly professed total closeness to the USSR, stating the PDPA teaches members patriotism, Marxism, Sovietism and internationalism.
Amin credited the Soviet embassy with being key to the victory of the Saur Revolution.
The meeting concerned Soviet-Afghan scientific and cultural cooperation after the April 1978 revolution.
Amin warned both sides would bear responsibility for any unrealistic projects.
